invariant:
fact named: bool
fact reject: bool
fact sealed_adopt: bool
fact sealed_reject: bool
check !(sealed_reject && sealed_adopt) && (!sealed_reject || (named && reject)) && (!sealed_adopt || (named && !reject))

next.named:
fact answer_reject: bool
fact answered: bool
fact named: bool
fact reject: bool
fact sealed_adopt: bool
fact sealed_reject: bool
check answered
next.reject:
fact answer_reject: bool
fact answered: bool
fact named: bool
fact reject: bool
fact sealed_adopt: bool
fact sealed_reject: bool
check answered && answer_reject
next.sealed_adopt:
fact answer_reject: bool
fact answered: bool
fact named: bool
fact reject: bool
fact sealed_adopt: bool
fact sealed_reject: bool
check sealed_adopt || (!sealed_reject && answered && !answer_reject)
next.sealed_reject:
fact answer_reject: bool
fact answered: bool
fact named: bool
fact reject: bool
fact sealed_adopt: bool
fact sealed_reject: bool
check sealed_reject || (!sealed_adopt && answered && answer_reject)
